title: Can't Travel, Lid Opens Way Too Easily
text: Can't Travel, Lid Opens Way Too Easily. Love the design and the handle, but oh man, the lid! The tiny little bump out you use to open it catches easily on things and the lid suction is not strong. It easily pops off and spills. This is really only meant as a nice mug for a stationary spot. I can't travel with it easily.

product_metadata.title: Spoontiques - Ceramic Travel Mugs - Batman Logo Cup - Hot or Cold Beverages - Gift for Coffee Lovers
features: Perfect For Your Commute - Spoontiques ceramic travel mugs are perfect for your daily drive. Whether you’re headed on a road trip, a day at the office, or out running errands you can keep your favorite beverage handy on the go!
Locking Lid - A secure locking lid with a skid-resistant bottom helps to prevent leaks and spills when you’re out on the road. Spoontiques mugs fit in most vehicle cup holders.
Measurements - Each ceramic travel mug stands 6 ½” tall and holds 18 ounces of liquid. Mugs are microwave and dishwasher safe. Mugs with foil are not safe for the dishwasher or microwave.

Darling Designs- Spoontiques travel mugs come in a variety of colorful designs to choose from. Everything from motivational quotes to funny sentiments, your favorite characters and everything in between!
Great Gifts - Whether you’re treating yourself or someone else, a Spoontiques mug makes a great stocking stuffer, secret Santa or a just because gift!
description: This ceramic travel mug is perfect for anyone on the go! with a locking lid and a skid-plated bottom, this mug is the perfect travel companion. The double wall insulation keeps drinks hot or cold, and it is both microwave and dishwasher safe.
